Hello Winning Putt Community! It's been a long time coming and I'm proud to release our next set of Patch Notes to prepare you for everything this new content update has to offer! From a New Course to a New Game Mode, a lot of changes are coming to Winning Putt!

So sit back, relax, and keep on scrolling to check out all the new changes coming after Maintenance on Thursday!

Updates 		https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/3fbf55773362706be12b5f82a52c6b500c6e1629.png New Mode: Jewel Rush			New Game Mode! Jewel Rush is a NEW game mode that introduces a whole new rule set and mechanics to Winning Putt! The core mechanics are the same, but you’ll have to adapt to a whole new system of items and course styles to be victorious!		Jewel Rush contains various colored jewels for you to collect.					Green, Yellow, and Red Jewels							Provide points with Green worth the least and Red worth the most!									Black Jewels							Deduct points from your score – avoid them!									Rainbow Jewels							These shiny jewels provide a random special effect while also recovering Stamina and Mentality!				Possible effects for Rainbow Jewels can be:									Double Score					Mega impact					Magnet					Shield					Attack Frenzy					Random Attack					Topple the King					Stamina Attack					Mentality Attack																				For more information, be sure to hit F1 in game to get the full primer!		

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/272aff958c07621bce02e15d2460b5d102f2bdfd.png New Course: Royal Old Links			Inspired from some of the more rustic courses out there, the Royal Old Links brings in some modern history with its lush greens and difficult hazards.			New Summer Seasonal Items			Check out some new items that we will be releasing to celebrate Summer! All items listed here will be available at the Event Shop!					New Baseball Bat Drivers							These Summer Drivers will push a “high risk, high reward” type of game play. Push yourself to the limits and see just how far you can drive!									New Summer Time Golf Balls!							Golf balls ready to have fun in the sun! Be on the lookout for some fun 2pc golf balls coming soon!									New Summer Time Clothes!							We have some new clothing items coming soon that focus on letting you decide how they’ll power up your play aka more slots to let you customize your character to fit your style of play!													Dragon Club Sets			We have a new set of clubs coming with this update! The Dragon Clubs!		These clubs focus on being awesome when it comes to Swing, and Precision.		These clubs are available through the Craft-o-Matic.		Their crafting supplies are available through the Guild Coin shop.		We will also be awarding materials to Players who do well in various competitive modes like the Volero Tour!			Player Privacy and Data Collection			Manage Data Options added the Menu UI		Changes		https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/c256bd19479ebe97cf532c2a643539e0dd32921d.png Course Master Changes​			We’re bringing Course Master more into line with our other features and changing how we handle success.		Instead of facing off against another Player’s replay data, we are shifting things to shooting below a certain score to unlock courses.		We’re actively looking at other ways to continually improve Course Master!			The Chilly Weather and Spring Clothing Box leaving the Event Shop on August 1 at 11AM PDT!	Summer Square Decorations			Be sure to check out all the Summer-inspired fun all throughout the Square!			Summer UI Decorations			Not limited to just the Square, we’ve skinned the UI to be just as bright and fun!		Bug Fixes	Fixed an issue where caddies sometimes appear in the water.	Fixed an issue where the blue lighting graphic effects are missing on the Laser Beam Clubs on courses where the weather is raining.	Fixed an issue where selected screen options reset after launching and re-launching the game.	Fixed an issue where Guild Mission requirements do not progress.	Fixed an issue where Players were occasionally not receiving mission credit towards the mission " Teaching Pro License! A Class (6)".	Fixed an issue where Players would appear partially in the ground after putting the ball with Lazer-Beam PT.	Fixed an issue where Black Accent Sneakers (M) graphics were not properly displayed when equipped by a Male character.	Fixed a text issue for the Schematic: V Letter description.	Fixed a text issue for the Necklace’s description.	Fixed an issue for when the "Low Life" achievement does not progress when fulfilling the achievement requirements.	Other various text fixes for Missions, Quests, and Descriptions.Content Update Celebration Gift	To celebrate the launch of this new content update, be sure to login and claim your awesome Summer Reward after Maintenance is finished! Note that we will be sending everyone both gender items. Feel free to dispose of the one that your character can't use.

notes.title: Patch Notes [02/08/18]
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/a829bf013a963ef90583c6806080c8930163ce87.jpg
Keep yourself up-to-date with all the changes coming to Winning Putt!

Happy New Year’s Winning Putt Community! It’s been a while since our last Patch Notes, but since then we’ve been tinkering around with things in preparation for today! Listed below are the big changes that are going to be applied after Maintenance and we hope that you’re as excited for them as we are! From new additions to major bug fixes, we’ve covered everything you need to know to golf your best out on the course.

Without further ado, here are the first Patch Notes for 2018!

New Additions

Guild League
A new play mode is finally here – the Guild League! Based on feedback we’ve received over the past year, the Guild League is a new mode that allows Guilds to go head-to-head in order to prove just who has the better golfers.

Setup in a similar way to Tournaments, the Guild League is comprised of multiple weeks of competition that fall under one entire Guild League season. Rewards are distributed at the end of every week with a larger reward being distributed at the end of the Season.

So you may be asking – how does the mode itself actually work? It’s quite simple really if you’ve ever played a Foursome mode before. Sharing one ball between each team, Players will try to shoot their best score while working together. One nifty addition designed to aid participants is the addition of the new GPS Marker Feature. This marker will make a clear on-screen mark anywhere on the course to help guide your Partner as you try to sync your shots.

At the end of each Match, you will be awarded points based on your performance. However, in addition to your scorecard, you will also be judged on how well you
actually did against your opponent. From landing the ball closer to the green to sinking the ball in less putts, there are a ton of ways to score points even if you didn’t win the hole!
​
Important Note: Because this is a new competitive mode that we’re still looking to adjust as time goes on, these first few seasons will be “Beta” or “Test” seasons that will also award different rewards than a typical season would.

Important Note 2: The Schedule for this first test run of the Guild League will be a little shorter than what we expect will be considered “normal”. Be sure to check out the schedule in-game at the Guild NPC to see the exact times and dates!

We will be asking for feedback throughout the Season so please be sure to send us your honest opinions! Be it through the forums, through a CS ticket, or on Social Media, we are excited to hear what you have to say!

Guild Coin Shop
While we accidentally gave a sneak peek into this new feature, the Guild Coin Shop is finally ready to open! We’ve heard your feedback about trying to spruce up Guilds and the Guild Coin Shop is one of the many features we’re excited to add into the game.

Packed with Consumables, Enchanting Items, Name Change Tickets, and Guild Kiosks, the Coin Shop allows Guild Members to work together to get the items they need! Green Coins (the currency for the Guild Shop) are obtained when Guildmates participate in the Guild League.
 
Important Note: You may notice that the Guild Coin Shop is still empty. Because the first few seasons of the Guild League will essentially be test runs, the rewards don’t include any of the Coins required to make purchases from the shop. As we get closer to the first official season, we’ll be sure to have all the juicy details in a future Patch Notes or Maintenance Notice!​

[Chat] Shout Changes
When you enter the game you may notice that you’re unable to use the Shout channel that we’re all used to utilizing when we’re looking for a slight change of pace (aka a different text color). In addition to another welcome chat box upgrade, we’ve changed the Shout feature slightly.

First and foremost, you’ll be unable to use Shout unless you have the new Disposable Megaphone item in your inventory. At this point in time, this item will only be available through the Guild Coin Shop.

Now you may be wondering – just what the heck does this new Shout feature do and why do I need an item to do it? Well my friends, instead of just showing up as different colored text, the Shout feature will now send your messages to everyone, be it in the Square, in a different Channel, or even in a Round.  Messages sent using this feature will be heard all around the Winning Putt World.

So the next time you’re looking for a game, or trying to find someone to queue with for Time Attack, or just trying to express how happy you are for pulling one stroke ahead during a Ranked Round, be sure to try out the new Shout feature!

[Chat] Emoji Additions
An addition that’s been overdue, we’ve finally added in some more modern emojis to the chatbox! Be more expressive as you take on others on the course – these new emotes have a unique character pose associated with them!

Skill Changes
One of the bigger changes coming to Winning Putt this patch are some changes to Skills and how Mentality and Stamina consumption is calculated.

Starting with the skills themselves, Common Skills won’t see any major changes and both Power and Accuracy will still be able to pick from them. That said, some Common Skills are being changed into Class specific skills. In keeping with the theme of both character types, Power Characters are getting Penetrating Shot skill while Accuracy Characters will be receiving the Rough Wood Shot and the Bunker Wood Shot skills.

In addition to these changes, both classes will also be receiving a new skill. For Power Characters, you will see PowerShot 2 once you’ve hit the prerequisite level and stat requirements. PowerShot 2 will provide you a +80 Power Increase to your shot, has no club restrictions, and can be used on any type of terrain. For Accuracy Characters, you’ll see StraightShot 2 as an option. Limited to Irons or Wedges, this skill can be used on any type of terrain and will automatically increase your “Nice Shot” chances.

To account for these changes (as well as make other types of training more appealing), the last change to all of this is the restriction of using one Stamina and one Mentality drink per hole. As we touched on in the Letter from the Groundskeeper, there’s rarely a situation where you wouldn’t use a skill to empower your shot since refilling on Stamina or Mentality was simply one click away. To combat this and create a more dynamic environment, we’re targeting the items that allowed situations like this to exist.

All that said, do not fret! Skills will for the most part will be getting a large reduction on how much Stamina and Mentality they drain. However, a good rule of thumb is if a skill has a large impact, it’ll most likely cost more to use.

Also – there’s now a Daily Mission that will allow Players to obtain Drinks on a more consistent basis.

Server Time / Display
For those of you who didn’t know, you can see what channel you’re currently in by taking a quick peek up in the top right-hand corner of your screen. However, if you keep looking there for a few seconds, you’ll notice that it will loop between showing your channel and the current server time. Something that may not mean much, but should assist Players who have been running into issues when dealing with Daily Missions or rewards.

/ping
The long-awaited ping feature is now here in Winning Putt. Curious if your game is acting up? Wondering whether or not network latency is affecting your shot? Type /ping into your chatbox to check your connection to the Winning Putt servers!

New Club Class
In an effort to continuously respond to the feedback we receive from the entire Player-base, today we’re happy to announce the release of the Indigo Clubs! These new clubs differ from other Clubs in a few significant ways. First and foremost, these clubs will always have a 100% success rate when enchanting. That’s right – these clubs will never fail when you try to enchant them. Second, these clubs can go all the way up to +50 on the enchanting scale. Something that sounds a little crazy on the surface, but isn’t all that bad when you consider that you’ll never fail while enchanting (plus we’ve adjusted the required materials and Gold cost to account for all those extra levels). Last but not least, these clubs will not have a set bonus like other clubs due to the amount of stats they can achieve based on their enchantment level.

To find these new Indigo Clubs, swing over to the Craft-o-Matic where you’ll see them in their entirety, ready to be crafted. That said, you’ll want to swing to the ETC tab where you’ll find Club Boxes for the Advanced Indigos. Now, you may notice that all of these clubs and boxes require the Indigo Trade Ticket to craft. These tickets will be obtainable through a Daily Mission that just requires you to play normally as well as from disenchanting other Indigo Clubs.

In a nutshell, these new clubs are designed to be a long-term investment where anything you put in won’t be lost to random chance.

The Daily Mission to obtain Indigo Tickets will automatically appear once you hit Level 27!

Square Decorations Change (Lunar New Years Themed)
With Winter slowly coming to an end and warmer temperatures coming back, the snow from the Square will be making an exit once the patch is live. Be sure to keep an eye out for a fan favorite that’s temporarily coming back to the Square with a new costume!

Note: We've drastically reduced the amount of fan favorite somethings that load onto the Square to avoid causing lag in the Square.

Character Deletion Timer Changes
We’re shortening the timers on how long it takes for a character to get deleted. For those of you who are trying to open up Character space, Character Deletion will now only take a total of 2 days.

Golf Ball Landing Effects
To help make your golf ball purchases feel even more valuable, we’ve added some new effects whenever you use Platinum Golf Balls. Keep an eye out for all the cool new effects as you duke it out on the course!
Balls with updated effects:
Flame Distance
eXtreme Lightning
The Blossom - S
eXtreme Bomber
Hurricane Distance
Bandai Namco Ball
The Alienware
Magical
Electronic
Acid
Confetti
Glacial
Rocket Ball
Rainbow Ball
Soccer Ball Golf Ball
+ 2 New Unreleased Balls



Valentine’s Day Event
It’s almost Valentine’s Day and you know what that means – it’s time for some lovey-dovey festivities!

As soon as this new update goes live, we will have turned on the hearts. And by hearts, I mean the temporary Quest Item called Valentine Hearts that you’ll use to turn into snazzy Valentine’s Day clothing!

Every time you shoot a Birdie, you’ll be awarded one of three different hearts based on the course you’re playing on. Once you’ve obtained enough hearts, swing over to the Craft-o-Matic and head to the ETC tab under crafting.

To clarify, the types of heart you receive when shooting a birdie is based on the course you’re playing on and is not random.

We can’t wait to see everyone rocking their new snazzy outfits!

Known Bugs
Power Run Skill
We are aware of the issue with Power Run and are trying to solve the issue as quickly as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please avoid using the skill or you may experience a decrease in driving distance when trying to use it.


Bug Fixes

Gratuitous amounts of text fixes on Missions, Items, and other various UI elements.
Removed the possibility of Snow appearing on Edelweiss.
Fixed a text bug on the Albatross Title.
Fixed an issue where the Pioneer Spacesuit (M) was untradeable after a certain period of time.
Fixed an issue with retry limits not displaying correctly for some Players.
Fixed a graphic issue where Caddies would sometimes disappear.
Fixed multiple issues related to Daily Missions not awarding awards.

notes.title: Patch Notes (September 2017)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/240967b5e75c80b44389a9fd3b2eefc3f53db799.jpg

Read up on all the upcoming changes coming to Winning Putt!

Hello Winning Putt Community! With the temperatures falling and the cool breeze of fall flowing around us, I'm proud to release the next set of Patch Notes for the third content update of 2017! Listed below is all the juicy information you've been waiting for. From new additions to the game to major bug fixes, we've covered everything you need to know to kick some butt out on the course.

New Additions

The Guild Vault

It's been a long time coming, but we're happy to announce that a Guild Vault has been added to the game! Essentially storage for Guilds, the Guild Vault offers a convenient way for Guilds to collect and distribute gold, facilitate storage, and provide a way for members to store things they otherwise may not have space for. All the while providing the Guild security and peace of mind with the ability to set different permissions for who can access what.
For a more detailed look at the Guild Vault, keep scrolling down!


Improvements to Power Characters

Power Characters are getting some changes in this upcoming content update.
Simply put:

Making it easier for them to land a NICE shot.
Decreasing the overall GPS Circle Size compared to before.
Increasing how much distance the Power stat provides, slightly decreasing the amount Swing provides.

Overall, we're aiming to make Power Characters truly embrace that "high risk, high reward" theme they were supposed to embody.​
We will be distributing Retraining Tickets to all Players who sign in between Thursday and Sunday!


Revamped Achievements

Something we've been working on for a while, the new revamped achievements come with updated text, a brand new UI window, and most importantly updated stats associated with the title you receive for completing achievements!

​
Eagle Missions Separated

Small quality of life change -- the Daily Eagle Missions has been changed to Shoot One Eagle, Get One Eagle Box that can be done a total of 3 times per day. (We're still working on getting the missions awarding completion during all modes of play)

 
Betting Rounds Gold Limit Increased

One of the most sacred parts of Golf is the unspoken rule of constantly trying to take money away from your buddies as you're playing the course. The max gold betting limit in Betting Rounds has been increased (a lot) to help facilitate this in-game.


PIN PHYSICS

Why is the title in all caps? Because today is a glorious day that marks the introduction of Pin Physics to Winning Putt. Just like in real-life, use the pole to your advantage (or hope it plays to your opponent's disadvantage) as you try to hit the perfect shot.


Character Slot Increase

We're increasing the maximum number of character slots from 2 to 3. To unlock the 3rd spot, pick up the new Character Slot Expansion item sold at the Support Agency!


Level Up Support Box [for Lower Players]

We haven't forgotten about our lower level players! In addition to the split tournaments (which we've adjusted a bit), Players under level 20 will now receive a nice bonus in the form of a gift box at levels 1, 5, 8, 11, 13, 16, and 20! This box will contain consumables, caddie contracts, and a few other nice gifts to help lower level players shoot their best out on the course.


Toggle-able Putting Grids

Not the biggest change, but hopefully a welcome one on some courses where the putting grid or the GPS can get pretty annoying. Starting as soon as maintenance is over, you can now toggle the putting grid or the GPS on or off to help your eyes take a breather on some of the harsh uphill putts. Press "o" while in a round to try it out!


Craft-o-Matic Improvements

Now when a player is trying to craft a club, they'll have the option to select which club is being used if they have more than one in their inventory. No more having your +7 Driver being gobbled up when you wanted the basic, non-shafted, non-enchanted one being used. To change the club you're using, click the club in the Craft-o-Matic window to bring up club selection window.


New Apparel

More details will be announced as they're released, but we have a lot of new apparel for you to pick from with the seasons changing. For some hints though, one of the outfits has a clear wrangler feel to it while another has a very royal type of style going on.


Alienware AlienFX Effects

For players running on Alienware machines, Winning Putt now has AlienFX integrated into the game! Whenever you take a shot, the lights on applicable systems and peripherals will react accordingly!
​

New Tour Banners

We've slightly changed where the banners are hanging and have added a new banner to display the winners for the new Split Tournament setup!



Known Bugs

Level Up Support Boxes currently have a bug where opening them may occasionally yield the incorrect number of items. Fix: Be sure not to have any of the items that the box contains in your inventory while opening. For example, if you have 50 yellow bolts and the box contains yellow bolts, make sure to remove the yellow bolts from your inventory temporarily before opening the box!

Caddies with Hole Durations incorrectly show holes left as seconds remaining. The counter is accurate, but confusing (if you have 100 Holes left, it incorrectly says 100 Seconds). The amount of holes remaining will be correct!

Caddies with Hole Durations currently do not update the counter mid-round. Once you've finished / exited a round, the amount of Holes remaining will update correctly.

Occasionally the tooltips in the new Achievement window may stick. Opening and closing the Achievement window will clear any stuck tooltips.


Bug Fixes

Repeatedly pressing the Renew button on a Caddie Contract won't eat all your Platinum now.
Fringe cases where Lucky Ball gauge would get stuck at 100% has been fixed.
Guild Missions showing incorrect Guild Members has been addressed.
Fixed situations where an opponent leaving a Ranked Round would cause the other player to lose points.
Fixed a bug where glasses were not appearing correctly over certain pieces of clothing.
Fixed a bug where chat messages from the "Companion" chat were visible in all chat filters.


Feature Guide: The Guild Vault
Click here to open the Guide in a new window!

http://res.cloudinary.com/takkun/image/upload/v1505863726/guild_vault_feature_guide_optimized_at6zka.jpg

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/240967b5e75c80b44389a9fd3b2eefc3f53db799.jpg
Our second content update of the year is here!

We’re proud to release the Patch Notes for the second content update of 2017! Listed below are the additions to new editions to the game, major bug fixes, and anything else you need to know to be ready for this new update! Below Bug Fixes are also two extra sections focused on giving you a primer for some new features and changes coming with this update.

P.S. This will be taking the spot of our typical Letter from the Groundskeeper for the month of June!

New Features & Updates
Guild Mission System

You’ve been asking for it and we’re here to deliver! This update ships with the New Guild Mission System, a completely separate set of missions that are focused about guild mates participating together to complete them! They have pretty hefty rewards, but will be tough to complete without the collective effort of your guild.
Missions themselves vary and could be anything from achieving birdie 1,000 times (as a guild) to driving the ball over 300,000 yards (again, as a guild).
Scroll down for more information!

Guild Max Level and Max Members Increased

The guild level cap has been increased to 30!
The guild member cap has also been increased to 50!

​Item Transfer between characters on the same account
We’ve tweaked the mail system and have added the ability for you to send mail to the characters on your account! Instead of having to find a middleman, you can now safely transfer things between your characters. As an added bonus, you can even use this new system as a pseudo storage system for items you don’t necessarily want in your inventory.​
Marketplace Improvements

We’ve tidied up the Marketplace with some quality-of-life improvements to help both buyers and sellers feel confident when listing a product. Besides tweaks to help with visibility of important equipment information (and a pop-up to confirm you really want to buy the item you’ve selected), we’ve also prevented players from listing items that have been used (aka no more used shiny stones).
Guild Kiosk Buff Timer Increased to 2 Hours

Addressing the issue of the Guild Kiosk Buff wearing off before you’d be able to complete an 18-hole round, we’ve doubled the timer’s time to 2 hours to make sure you get the proper bonuses while you’re on the course.​
Club Crafting Change

Big changes are coming for players who are interested in crafting clubs through the Craft-o-matic.
Schematics for specific types of clubs have been replaced with schematics for brands of clubs (Vedas and TINQ). These schematics can be used in crafting any clubs from their respective brand, depending on the grade of the schematic. New Schematic Lock Box items contain Schematic Letter items of different grades which can be used to craft the schematics of the same grade. Vedas schematics require the letters “V”, “E”, “D”, “A”, and “S” while TINQ clubs require the letters “T”, “I”, “N”, and “Q”. Schematic Lock Boxes can be obtained as a possible Lucky Ball reward for players starting at level 26.
Schematics that players currently own can be converted to Vedas schematics of the same grade for a small Gold fee at the Craft-o-Matic.
Schematic Lock Boxes will be available through Lucky Ball Drops or purchasable at the Event Shop.​
TINQ Clubs Added

“The Distance” clubs can be used by level 31 or higher characters and have a heavy emphasis on Swing. A “Club Schematic: Tinq” of the appropriate grade (along with other relevant crafting materials) will be needed to craft these clubs.​
Season Rewards are being updated

Ranked Round: All “Schematic Box” items now contain the new “Club Schematic: Vedas” and “Club Schematic: Tinq” items instead of the previous club-specific schematics.  The items that can be obtained from these boxes are of the same grade as the previous rewards. For example, the “Premium Club Schematic Box” will now award either a “Premium Club Schematic: Tinq” or “Premium Club Schematic: Vedas” instead of a Premium schematic for a specific type of club.​
Guild Banners have been Updated!

Pretty self-explanatory.


Bug Fixes
Lucky Ball Gauge

While we’ve quietly been rolling in fixes throughout the past month, the release of this new build should mark the end of all those wonky Lucky Ball Gauge issues that some players were experiencing.
National Shirts for Gold

Stats have been properly added to the bugged National Shirts and they should be available in the Apparel Shop shortly after Winning Putt comes back online from maintenance.
Premium GPS Wind Arrows

Arrows representing wind direction have been fixed and now appear properly when using the Premium GPS.
​Stray White Pixels

We’ve removed the stray pixels that some players were seeing on the Square and on various in-game menus.
​Bonus EXP from Sponsorships or Kiosks

Tweaked the backend to make sure the amount of Bonus EXP awarded is accurate.
​Non-Tradeable Premium GPS from the shop

Has now been fixed and is always tradeable.
Known Bugs

Visual Bug, Blue Letter Lockboxes animation only shows one during box opening. Player receives correct amount.
Visual Bug, Players may occassionally see the golf ball clip into certain areas after shooting a ball out of bounds.

Guild Missions
Are you ready to be the very best that there ever was?

With our next update release comes a big new feature: Guild Missions!

These missions are completely separate from your personal missions and require the collaborative effort of your entire guild to complete. With big rewards at stake, will your guild be able to persevere and claim the top prizes?

To put it simply, Guild Missions are a new feature that are designed to reward guilds who get their members to support one another as they try to reach a weekly goal. These goals could be hitting the ball over 300,000 yards to achieving 1,000 birdies.

Everything you need to know about these Guild Missions can be found under the new Guild Mission tab within the Guild Menu.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/38f0f513df07f1ab9de28d129dce43923ac0f288.jpg

1. Mission Objective & Time Remaining: Your guild’s current mission and how long you have left to reach the goal. These missions will change every week and your guild will be rewarded based on many steps your guild manages to clear.
2. Step and Progress Bar: The Step shows how far up the ladder your guild is currently at (clearing more steps means better prizes) and the Progress Bar shows how many more completion points you need to clear the current step.
3. Members / Rewards: The members tab will show each guild member’s contributions to the Guild Mission. The Rewards tab will show all the steps and what the reward is for completing that step.

There is a limit to how much a single member can contribute to the Guild Mission. This limit is the “limit point” and is double the amount that each guild member is expected to contribute.
4. Reward Bonuses: The Reward Bonus section will show what bonus multipliers the Guild has reached and any additional rewards that the Guild obtains. Only the most cohesive Guild will obtain the top rewards and bonuses!
5. Previous Mission Info: This tab will bring up the previous mission’s information as well as allow the Guild Leader to claim the reward for the Guild Mission once the next one begins. Note that the Guild Leader will be the one who receives the reward and it will be up their discretion how to distribute it.
​
Extra Important Points

No Guild Mission points will be rewarded if you quit mid-round.
Foursome and Fourball (unless specified) will not gain you Guild Mission Points.
Shooting in the Driving Range will not provide you with Guild Mission Points.
Once you’ve reached your Point Limit, you can no gain any extra points until the next mission begins.


Club Crafting 2.0
We’re making some changes to Club Crafting!

Here's a brief primer on the changes coming to Club Crafting set to debut in the next content update. In a nutshell, we’re trying to make crafting a bit easier in the long run, especially if there’s a certain club you’re trying to get.

To kick things off we’re revamping how Schematics work and how you obtain Schematics for the type of club you want. In a nutshell we’re reducing the variation and total number of Schematics so it’s easier to obtain the one you want. By separating schematics by grade and brand instead of club, you’ll be able to use schematics for any type of club within a specific set.

Sound confusing? Let’s dive into an example.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/6a8b2706d9a44566d2567af59bc5b2af6cdd26cb.jpg
Using the [Advanced] Ultra G-Speed G DR (a Vedas branded club) as an example, you’ll need the following items to craft it: 374 Titanium Alloy Rods, 64 Advanced Club Cartridges, and the new Advanced Club Schematic: Vedas schematic.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/7eaf1b4c5b0d577c909fd63f4905771aa62d4eb2.jpg
This schematic is not club specific and will be the same one you use if you also wanted to craft any other club like an iron or even a putter!
* Expert and Premium clubs still require the previous club in order to craft them in addition to the Expert or Premium versions of the schematic.*

Crafting Schematics
Now, you may be wondering – How do I craft these new schematics? And what about the schematics I already have?

Starting with the former, we’re introducing new Schematic Letters that you’ll obtain from opening Schematic Lock Boxes. These Lock Boxes will be obtainable as Lucky Ball Drops or purchasable for Platinum.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/99b2b7457296e16b95dd76ca55aba3cdf3c5b686.jpg
When opening these different boxes, you’ll be awarded Schematic Letters that could be Advanced, Expert, or Premium grades depending on the box. And once you’ve collected the right letters (TINQ for Tinq clubs or VEDAS for Vedas Clubs), you’ll be able to craft the corresponding schematic based on the grade of the letters.

* Yes, the schematics for each respective brand will be crafted by spelling out their name.*
* Currently, there is a visual bug where Blue Lock Boxes only show 1 letter being given. The correct amount will appear in your inventroy. *

Now, for the elephant in the room – what happens to the schematics I already have? Unfortunately, they won’t be useable with the new crafting system. However, you’ll be able to convert any schematics into the corresponding grade Vedas schematic! So if you have an Expert Putter schematic you’ll be able to convert it into an Expert Club Schematic: Vedas which can then be used for any club!

And there you have it! With the goal of simplifying things in mind, we’re excited to see just how many more players are able to craft the clubs they’ve had their eyes on. As always we’re open to feedback and will be eagerly waiting to see what you have to say on the forums and through our social media!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/5435fa7907dbc4556c446069ca705aeed69abaed.jpg

Patch Notes for March 9th, 2017

After many rounds of testing and verifying that everything is working properly, we’re proud to present to you the Patch Notes for March 9th, 2017! With spring quickly descending upon us, come celebrate with us as we unleash a wave of green onto the square. And while you’re at it, why not take a peek at the brand new Marketplace?

New Additions and Changes

 The level cap has been increased from 35 to 40.
 Level 40 equipment has been added to the game.
 Level 35+ missions have been added to the game.
 Level 35+ Achievements have been added to the game.
 The long awaited Marketplace has been added to the game!
 New Club Craft recipes have been added to the game.
  Harsh Cape is out of beta and now officially open!
  Harsh Cape has been added to the Course Master list.
 Players may now access Harsh Cape at Level 22. 
 Rewards for shooting a Hole-In-One, Albatross, or Eagle have been improved. 
 Fairway DR Skill has been adjusted [Increased Stamina and Mentality Cost]
 Warmer spring weather means the snow has melted away!
  The snow has been removed from Edelweiss.
  The snow has been removed from the Driving and Practice Range.
  The snow has been removed from the Square.

Rewards for shooting a Hole-In-One, Albatross, or Eagle have been improved.

 Hole-in-One Reward Box Will Contain:
 
 Apple (40 Accuracy), The One (4pc), Basic Accuracy Necklace, and Refined Leather.

 Albatross Reward Box Will Contain:

  Energy Bar (80 Swing), Power Distance (2pc), Shiny Stone (50 Hole), Titanium Alloy Rod Box, Refined Leather Box.

 Eagle Rewards Reward Box Will Contain:

 Energy Bar (80 Swing), eXtreme Spin (3pc), Basic Power Necklace, and Titanium Alloy Rod

 The amount of items you receive are based on the difficulty of the course you're playing on.
 Companions in your Companion Group will receive gold as well!

Guild Related

 Guild Name Change Tickets are now available at the Support Agency for 400,000 Gold.

  Only the Guild Master can use the ticket to change the Guild Name.

 The Guild Membership bug has been fixed and member counts should be accurate. 

New Items

 Character Name Change Tickets are now available at the Support Agency for 3,495 Platinum.
 Winter Costume Boxes are available at the Event Store for 795 Platinum until March 31st!

Update for Clarity: You Only Get One Item per Box (Similar to other Lucky Boxes).

 Grand Championship Tickets can now be used to craft Improved Founders Pack Equipment at the Craft-o-matic.

  A Ticket will provide 1 Head Piece and 1 Top Piece.


Smaller Changes

 Ties during Ranked Rounds will now end in a draw.

  Tie games will now result in each player earning 3 Ranked Points.
  The controversial tie-breaker systems have been removed.

 The rewards for Golden Ball or Lucky Ball have been improved.
 Ball animations have been sped up to reduce the time between each shot.

Bug Fixes

 Guild Member counter now goes down after deleting a member.
 When UI is hidden, your character name will also be hidden.
 Course Master replay data has been updated with newer statistics. 
 Updated text and grammar throughout various Missions.

**Known Issues**

 The Marketplace shows an incorrect transaction fee of 20% after selling an item.

  The Marketplace will actually charge the correct transaction fee of 5% for players with an active Gold Membership Contract, and 10% for all other players.

 NPCs may disappear after using a Character Name Change Ticket.

  Restarting the game will repair the issue and make the NPCs visable again.

 Character name may not update on the Leaderboard after using a Character Name Change Ticket.

 A fix is in the works and the issue will be addressed at a later time.
